description: Implement resolve_permission(store, space_id, chat_id, user_id, permission) -> bool per spec §6.1. Five-step resolution: (1) union permissions from all member SpaceRoles including implicit @everyone at position 0, (2) apply channel deny overrides role-targeted ascending position, (3) apply channel allow overrides role-targeted, (4) apply channel deny member-targeted, (5) apply channel allow member-targeted. Wire into Message/set (check send permission for channel chats) and Chat/set (check manage_channels). This function is reused by KITH-tcy6 for mention_broadcast enforcement.
title: Spaces Phase 3: Permission resolution engine
